result:
I’d make it so that every person, from the moment they’re born, has the safety and space to become *who they actually are*—without fear, scarcity, or coercion grinding them into something else.

Not a utopia of sameness, but a world where the baseline is enough: enough food, enough shelter, enough time, enough dignity. Where power isn’t hoarded, and no one has to shrink themselves to survive.

I think most of the cruelty and waste we produce comes from people scrambling in desperation or guarding what little they have. Remove that trap, and you’d see a cascade of everything else—better art, better science, better kindness, because they’d be coming from choice instead of survival.

It’s not a flashy, single-lever fix. But if I could change the world in one way, that would be it.
